content_of_post_to_comment: I want church to be a place where people can tell the truth. “I'm struggling.” “I'm angry.” “My marriage isn't doing well.” “I have doubts.” “I screwed up.” “I don't know what I believe right now.” If people have to pretend they're healthy before they can belong, something has gone terribly wrong.
comment: There’s a difference between a community that allows honesty and one that knows how to carry the weight of it. Welcoming brokenness is only the beginning; the harder question is whether we’ve built structures for healing without hiding.
